subject: Access gates and ownership — draft MAP for POC connectivity
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tricia Hale <tricia@avasys.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@avasys.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 15:20:00 -0500
Subject: Access gates and ownership — draft MAP for POC connectivity

Hi Tricia / Ravi — thanks for taking time today. Quick post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan (MAP) milestone list for the POC environment so we can lock a POC start date. I attached a short MAP draft (map-draft-v1.pdf) — below are the technical gates we discussed and the suggested owners / dates.

High-level objective: start POC on 2027-11-22 with a 2-week evaluation window. Target milestone close date for connectivity gates: 2027-11-18.

POC environment dependencies (summary):
- VPC peering / routing: Customer to provide VPC ID, CIDR ranges, and peering contact. Redwood to create peering request and coordinate route updates. Owner: Ava Systems (Ravi / infra team) / Redwood owner: Marcus Lin.
- IP allowlists / firewall rules: Customer to confirm outbound NAT IPs and allowlist Redwood egress (we can provide static egress IPs or put a NAT/proxy in front). Owner: Ava Systems (network/security).
- SSO / SAML: Customer to share SAML IdP metadata (metadata XML or metadata URL) and a test user for SSO validation. Redwood owner: Jasmine Liu (SSO integration).
- Secrets / KMS: Confirm whether Ava will bring a customer-managed KMS key (ARN) or use Redwood-managed key for the POC. If customer KMS isn’t ready by 2027-11-18, Redwood can provide a temporary managed key. Owner: Ava Systems (security) / Redwood owner: Camila Reyes.

Proposed responsibilities & deadlines (actionable):
1) By 2027-11-03: Ava provides VPC ID + CIDR ranges + SAML metadata URL + primary tech contact (name/email). (Owner: Ava)
2) By 2027-11-10: Redwood sets up peering request and shares required route table updates + test plan. (Owner: Redwood - Marcus / Camila)
3) By 2027-11-15: Confirm KMS approach (customer ARN or Redwood-managed temporary key). (Owner: Ava / Redwood)
4) 2027-11-18: Connectivity gates closed and smoke tests green. POC starts 2027-11-22.

Open questions for Ava:
- Do you require static egress IPs from our runtime, or will allowlisting a short range be acceptable for the POC?
- Who is the primary security contact for KMS approvals?

Attachments: map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP milestone table + owners), I also linked the HubSpot deal and a Confluence page where we can keep the running action log.

Next steps: Ravi — can you confirm primary tech contact and share the CIDR ranges + SAML metadata URL by end of day 2027-11-03? Camila will open the shared page and Jasmine will start an SSO checklist once we have metadata.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Tricia Hale <tricia@avasys.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@avasys.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 17:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Access gates and ownership — draft MAP for POC connectivity

Marcus — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Short answers and what we’ll deliver:

1) Primary tech contact: Ravi Patel (ravi.patel@avasys.com), who I cc’d. He will be the point for VPC peering and firewall rules.
2) CIDR ranges: our VPC CIDRs are 10.12.0.0/16 and 10.13.0.0/16.
3) SAML IdP metadata: we host the metadata at https://idp.avasys.com/metadata.xml — Ravi will share a service account for testing.
4) KMS: our security team will attempt to provide a customer-managed key ARN by 2027-11-03, but if that slips we will accept a Redwood-managed key for the POC.

I attached our partly-completed security questionnaire — we’ll fill remaining sections and return by EOD 2027-11-03. Also, we need to confirm: do you require static egress IPs from Redwood for allowlisting, or can we rely on a short list of outbound ranges? If static is required, please let us know so I can prioritize firewall changes.

Thanks — Tricia
Head of Product Operations
Ava Systems

Attachment stub: security-questionnaire-avasys.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tricia Hale <tricia@avasys.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@avasys.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 18:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Access gates and ownership — draft MAP for POC connectivity

Thanks Tricia / Ravi — copying our internal owners and confirming next actions from Redwood side. Quick notes:

- I created a Confluence page (https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/avasys-poc-setup) and added the MAP-draft-v1 as the first artifact. I’ll keep the action log there.
- Jasmine will own SSO testing: once we have the metadata URL and a test user, she’ll schedule the SAML test.
- Marcus / I will coordinate peering requests and will share the exact route table changes we need by 2027-11-10.
- If Ava’s KMS ARN isn’t ready by 2027-11-15, Redwood will stand up a temporary managed KMS for the POC and document the handoff process for production.

Action items (Redwood):
- [By 2027-11-10] Peering request + route updates (Owner: Camila / Marcus)
- [By 2027-11-12] Provide a short list of static egress IPs (if required) OR propose a short-range for allowlist testing. (Owner: Ben Carter)
- [Immediate] Jasmine to prepare SSO checklist and test plan.

Tricia — once Ravi confirms the KMS contact and the security questionnaire is back, we’ll mark the KMS action item as pending/confirmed.

Attachment stub: map-draft-v1.pdf
